---
name: Feature or integration proposal
about: Suggest a usability improvement, independent AXQ integration or new capability
---

## User problem

Who would use this, and what is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior

Include a CLI example or integration workflow and relevant compatibility limits.

## Contribution

Describe any implementation or testing help you can offer. First-time contributors,
forks and independent readers/exporters are welcome; no hardware is required
for documentation and synthetic-test contributions.
